summary.text: Rae C. Cousins is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 79th District, which covers part of the city of Richmond, and has served since January 10, 2024.
Cousins sits on the House committees on Courts of Justice, Public Safety, Education and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Rae C. Cousins was born in Richmond, Virginia, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Cousins's education as The College of William and Mary (B.A., 2001), Howard University School of Law (JD, 2010).
The profile gives Cousins's occupation as attorney.

Cousins's listed memberships and affiliations include Richmond Democratic Committee (Former 3rd Vice Chair), Peter Paul Development Center (Board Member), Anna Julia Cooper School (Board Member), Oakwood Arts (Board Member), Afrikana Film Festival (Board Member), Crusade for Voters, Hill Tucker Bar Association.
